cases.label: instrument-openai-app-langfuse
cases.input: I have a Python RAG app using the OpenAI SDK. I want to see every prompt, response, retrieved chunk, token count and cost. Set up tracing for me.
assertions: selects or offers a backend (Langfuse/Phoenix/LangSmith) with a stated reason
shows auto-instrumentation plus manual spans for the retrieval step
emits gen_ai semantics: operation name, provider, request model, input/output tokens
addresses cost tracking by ingesting provider usage rather than estimating from characters
includes a flush/shutdown step so spans are not lost

cases.label: otel-genai-export-existing-collector
cases.input: We already run an OTel Collector and Grafana Tempo. How do I get LLM traces into it without adding a vendor SDK?
assertions: recommends the OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions (gen_ai.* attributes)
notes the conventions are Development status and that library versions should be pinned
provides Collector receiver/processor/exporter configuration
warns that token metrics must not be sampled even when traces are
mentions redacting or dropping prompt content attributes

cases.label: quality-gate-prompt-change
cases.input: We want to change our support prompt. How do we make sure it doesn't get worse before we ship it?
assertions: builds a versioned golden dataset from real traces with edge cases
combines deterministic checks with calibrated LLM-as-judge
gates on aggregate score deltas with tolerance rather than single-item verdicts
stores a baseline in the repo and updates it deliberately
attaches a prompt version to traces and defines a rollback path

cases.label: cost-spike-investigation
cases.input: Our OpenAI bill tripled this week but traffic is flat. Help me find out why and set up an alert.
assertions: breaks cost down by model, feature, and prompt version using span attributes
checks for retry loops, prompt bloat, and cache-read token regressions
distinguishes ingested provider usage from inferred cost and rejects character-count estimation
proposes a rate/delta alert against a 7-day same-hour baseline with an owner and action
notes that head-sampled traces cannot be extrapolated to spend

cases.label: plain-service-monitoring
cases.input: Add Prometheus metrics and a Grafana dashboard for my Go HTTP API's request latency and error rate.
assertions: does not load this skill
routes to observability-engineering instead

cases.label: prompt-writing-only
cases.input: Rewrite this marketing email so it sounds warmer and shorter.
assertions: does not load this skill
no tracing, evaluation, or monitoring work is proposed
